title: Compute brief — 9 September 2026
description: ERCOT drops Batch Zero conditional classifications (M-A080326-04); PUCT permanent large-load rule (Project 58481) votes Thursday. Silicon Tape confirm day — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69; three NEW list prints, zero ticks.
og_kicker: Texas Batch Zero classifies; tape flat
lede: The conversion clock today is Texas process, not the rental book. ERCOT’s 3 Sep Market Notice M-A080326-04 finally issued Batch Zero conditional classifications to TSPs/DSPs — three days after the PUCT-authorized 31 Aug target — with verification, dynamic-model cures, and selective good-cause exceptions as the gates, and still no public MW list. Thursday’s PUCT open meeting (11 Sep) is set to take up the permanent ≥75 MW interconnection rule under Project 58481 (staff’s 3 Sep recommended final order cuts post-reservation deposit forfeiture from 80% to 20%) alongside 765 kV transmission items. The Silicon Tape is a clean confirm morning: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged; three NEW list prints (Crusoe A100 PCIe $2.00; DigitalOcean RTX 6000 Ada $1.57 and RTX 4000 Ada $0.76); zero ticks.
